identity.canonicalName: Zara Home Cordless Metal Table Lamp, Maroon

classification.verdict: Zara's take on a popular shape
classification.verdictNote: Zara's own version of the cordless cone lamp. A reverse image search found it only at Zara Home and Zara.
classification.summary: A small cordless lamp from Zara Home with no credited designer. A reverse image search found this exact lamp only at Zara Home and Zara, so it isn't a relabeled factory item, but glossy cone-shade lamps are a broad trend right now. The best-known high-end version is In Common With's Eave table lamp ($850), which is much taller; Zara's is a 4.7-inch mini, not a copy of it.

designer.note: None credited; Zara Home's in-house team

specs.label: Size
specs.value: 4.7 in H × 6.3 in W × 6.3 in D

specs.label: Material
specs.value: Iron base and shade, glossy maroon finish

specs.label: Battery
specs.value: Rechargeable Li-ion, about 8 hours per charge, 4 hours to charge, USB-A to USB-C cable included

quality: A tiny glossy iron lamp: a cone shade on a short stem over a flat disc base, all in a deep maroon enamel. At 4.7 inches tall it's a shelf or tabletop accent, not something to read by.
120 lumens is very dim, about a fifth of a standard bulb, so think candle substitute. The LED and battery are built in and can't be replaced, which limits how long it lasts.

maker.name: Zara Home
paragraphs: Zara Home is the home decor chain of Inditex, the Spanish group behind Zara. It launched in 2003, is based in A Coruña, Spain, and sells bedding, tableware, furniture and decor through its own stores and website.
Like Zara, it follows fast-moving trends with frequent new collections, and many pieces come from the same factories that supply other brands. It doesn't credit designers on most items.

sources.title: Zara Home: Cordless Metal Table Lamp

worth.line: Only as a mood light: a cute glossy accent for $56, but too dim to light a room.

price.note: Same $55.90 at Zara Home and Zara, the only places selling it.

materials.note: Solid iron with a glossy enamel finish, but only 120 lumens and a battery you can't replace.
